translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Ilaitia deli bulibuli

E taitala tovitoubobuta yagala Ilaitia, tolela Tisibe mapilana Giliadi, e matauna ikaibiga baisa guyau Eyabi, kawala, “Yeigu wodola Guyau Tomomova, mina Isireli si Yaubada, matauna auwotitali. E mapaila alukwaim baisa makawala - gala wala bitabani sikukula kaina kuna
olopola taitu kwaiyu kaina kwaitolu bimaisi, igau wala avai tuta balivala bima.”
E matutowena tuta Guyau Yaubada iluki Ilaitia kawala,
“Kusilavi makatupona valu kulaga opilibomatu e baisa bukusipepuni katitaikinela Sakala Keriti mapilana Yoridani opilibomatu.
Sakala bisisakaim sopila bukumomom, e deli baisa ulo karaiwaga bulibuli bimiakaimsi kʹam mapilana valu.”
E Ilaitia ikabikuwoli Guyau la karaiwaga e bogwa ila isisu katitaikinela Sakala Keriti.
Matauna imomom sopi metoya wa sakala, e igau bulibuli imiakaisi kaula deli gwaba yam kwaitala kwaitala, kaukwau deli koyavi.
E igau tuta oluvi sakala imada, paila uula gala kuna.
Ilaitia deli kwabuya vilela Sarepata
E Guyau iluki Ilaitia, kawala,
“Baisa tuta bukula valu mapilana Sarepata, katitaikinela Saidoni, e baisa bukusisu. Bogwa lakaraiwogi natana kwabuya isisu baisa bivakomaim.”
Mapaila Ilaitia ila Sarepata. E tutala bogwa leima okalapisilela mapilana valu, e igisi natana kwabuya eisosewa kai. E iluki minana, kawala, “Ve! Kumai sitana sopi amom.”
E minana ila paila bimai sopi, e matauna idou kawala, “Ve! Sitana kaula kumiakaigu.”

E ivitakauloki kawala, “Wi! Ka, alivala biga katotila mwau omatala Guyau m Yaubada Tomomova, gala wala sitana ayosi kaula. Kala bawa pwarawa eisisu okaboma bitakipatu wala. Deli, olibe bulamila lodu wala eisisu olukwava. Ka, lama baisa asoububuna sitana kai e bakaimilivau wa bwala bakatubiasi avaka pikekita paila sogu latugu. Baisa kala vigimkovila ma kamkwam, e oluvi bakasisu goli kama molu bakakaliga.”

E Ilaitia iluki minana, kawala, “Gala bimwau nanom. Kula wala kukwatubiasi paila bukukwamsi. Mitaga bikugwa kugabu kwaitala beredi kwekekita metoya baisa avaka lokuiyosi e kumiakaigu, e kesalaga kukwatubiasi paila yoku som latum.

Paila ka, baisa makawala Guyau da Yaubadasi yakidasi mina Isireli eilivala. Kawala, ‘Okaboma makaina pwarawa gala biwokuva e bulami olukwava gala biwokuva bisisu wala igau kala yam makwaina yeigu Guyau bawitali kuna.’”
E minana kwabuya ila ivagi makawala avaka Ilaitia leiluki, e komwaidosi matausina ikamkwamsi kʹasi ibodi wala yam makwaisina.
Makawala Guyau bogwa eilivala biga katotila baisa Ilaitia, e mapaila pwarawa okaboma gala iwokuva deli bulami olukwava gala iwokuva.
E kwaivila yam bogwa leiwokuva, minana kwabuya latula tau ikatoula, e kala katoula iyouloveka sainela mapaila magudina gwadi ikaliga.

E minana iluki Ilaitia kawala, “Mwa, yokula Yaubada la tomota, avaka uula kuvigakaigu makawala ke? Ki, lokuma baisa kidamwa bukuyoluluwai Yaubada paila ulo mitugaga e bivigaki uula latugu la kaliga ke?”

Mapaila Ilaitia ikaibiga kawala, “Kusakaigu matauna gwadi!” E ikau magudina gwadi metoya oyamala inala, e ikopwi ilau matabudona la kabomasisi mabuligana walakaiwa e ivakaniyeli magudina gwadi okabala.

E oluvi inigada kawala, “Mwa Guyau ulo Yaubada, avaka uula lokuvagi vavagi makwaina saina gaga baisa minana kwabuya? Ka, minana saina namitakwai goli mapaila eivaulaigu. Mitaga tuta baisa lokukwatumati latula!”
E oluvi Ilaitia isivatolu ikanakaila odabala gwadi magudina e oluvi inigada kawala, “Mwa Guyau ulo Yaubada, kukwaimilivau la momova gwadi magudina!”
E Guyau imapu Ilaitia la nigada, e gwadi magudina ivitouula iyagisa e imovavau.
E Ilaitia ilupi gwadi magudina imiaki inala mabuligana watanawa, e iluki minana, kawala, “Ve! Kugisi, latum bogwa leimova!”
E minana ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka, tuta baisa bogwa lanikolaim, yoku goli Yaubada la tomota, deli mokwita wala matauna ililivala metoya baisa yoku!”

footnotes.text: Baisa bivituloki kidamwa Guyau Yaubada, matauna mina Isireli si Yaubada, kalamwaleta wala matauna iyosi karaiwaga paila kuna, e gala goli minana Beali, mina Saidoni si yaubada.
